name: Milestone
description: A planned target that groups tasks within a project: a version in Redmine, a milestone in GitHub or GitLab, a fix version in Jira. It has a name, a due date and a state. Type https://datamodels.jp/ns/task/Milestone; @context https://datamodels.jp/context/task/v1.jsonld.

project.description: The project this belongs to (a URI)

start.description: Planned start: a date, or a date and time

due.description: Due: the planned release or completion, a date or a date and time

milestoneStatus.description: State: open, locked (no new tasks may be added) or closed; status is protected in the core context, hence milestoneStatus

source.description: URL of this object in the system of record (a URI)

externalId.description: Identifier in the system of record

dateCreated.description: Creation time in the system of record (distinct from the broker attribute createdAt)

dateModified.description: Last modification time in the system of record
